name: Aoto
tagline: Tokyo in 33 minutes and Otemachi in 34 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Katsushika City, where Keisei run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 47 minutes to Shinjuku, 53 minutes to Shibuya and 44 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 0.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.9 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 0.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.1 m to 1.8 m, a difference of 1.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 19 clinics and 15 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. No facility recorded as a hospital lies within 2.5 km of the station. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. Keisei Main Line and Keisei Oshiage Line run through it. Narita Sky Access Line also call here. All 3 lines are run by Keisei, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Keisei Oshiage Line runs at 157% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 京成曳舟→押上, which this station is not on. Keisei Main Line runs at 137%. Its busiest stretch is 大神宮下→京成船橋, which this station is likewise not on. Narita Sky Access Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥120,000 to ¥130,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Aoto is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Aoto in a straight line. Both have the Keisei Oshiage Line. Aoto also has the Keisei Main Line and Narita Sky Access Line, which Keisei-Tateishi does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On how easy the shopping is, Aoto comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Aoto has 9 supermarkets (ジュピター and リブレ京成 and others) and Keisei-Tateishi has 4.

neighbours.lead: For what it offers families, Keisei-Takasago; for the number of medical facilities, Aoto.
neighbours.note: About 1 km from Aoto in a straight line. Both have the Keisei Main Line, Keisei Oshiage Line and Narita Sky Access Line. Keisei-Takasago also has the Keisei Kanamachi Line and Hokuso Line, which Aoto does not. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On the number of medical facilities, Aoto comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Aoto has 34 clinics and pharmacies and Keisei-Takasago has 13.

noiseSources: The nearest big road, 環七通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Mornings here are less crowded than the line figures suggest: the lines are busy, but this station is outside their busiest stretches.
